title: Chapter 695 - 695 Core Area; Enlightenment Tablet!
content:
Chapter 695 - 695 Core Area; Enlightenment Tablet!

Chapter 695 - 695 Core Area; Enlightenment Tablet!

695 Core Area; Enlightenment Tablet!

In the dense forest of the Heavenly Wind World, a few figures discussed in low voices.

“Didn’t the elders say that there are many strange beasts in the Heavenly Wind World that have Spiritual Pearls? Why haven’t we killed any of them?”

“The thing is that there are too few mutated beasts here. I haven’t seen one in months.”

“There are many opportunities in the core area. I have to think of a way to enter.”

“The strong prey on the weak. We should use some special methods! Go to the east and lay in ambush!”

“Alright!”

…

Similar discussions rose and fell in the outer region of the Heavenly Wind World.

Therefore, more and more people headed east even though they had not gathered ten Spiritual Pearls.

…

As a result, Lin Fan and Ma Zheng encountered a few waves of robbers on their way to the core region.

They were all easily taken care of by Lin Fan. In fact, Lin Fan had even taken all of their belongings.

When Lin Fan found out the reason for the robbery, his expression turned weird.

Of course, these things were just a small interlude to him.

A month later, Lin Fan and Ma Zheng arrived in front of a huge door.

It was heavy and dignified.

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng each held ten Spiritual Pearls in their hands and came to the door.

The ten Spiritual Pearls turned into streams of light that revolved around the two of them.

Then, the two of them directly passed through the door.

In the next moment, they arrived at a stone forest.

Not far away, loud bangs rang out.

“Put down the Planet-level sword and I can spare your life!” the short man said.

“Not dead? Hahaha! What a joke. You?” the tall man with a full beard said.

“The treasured sword is mine!” someone else shouted.

“Those who are not afraid of death, come!” the bearded man said.

The Heavenly Wind World only allowed cultivators who were younger than 10,000 years old to enter. Planet-level treasures were attractive to them.

Several figures either chased or attacked each other… The wind howled, and rocks flew everywhere.

After a while, the bearded man rushed toward Lin Fan.

“Get lost!” he yelled.

As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly swung his saber.

A sharp and swift blade light shot toward Lin Fan.

Ma Zheng’s entire body went numb, and the aura of death surged into his heart.

Unblockable!

Lin Fan’s expression remained calm as he lifted his eyelids slightly.

Then, he pulled out the True Dragon Sword.

He swung his sword, and a dragon’s roar sounded.

The saber in the bearded man’s hand broke.

“How is that possible?” he asked in shock.

Then, his entire body was cut in half. He fell to the ground stiffly and lost all his vitality.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-six Planet cultivator. You’ve gained 60,000 experience.]

When the people chasing after the bearded man saw this, their bodies all froze, and their faces were filled with horror.

“Another Planet-level weapon? No! Perhaps it’s a legendary Emperor-level weapon!”

“What a powerful force!”

Lin Fan raised his eyelids slightly.

It turned out that an Emperor-level weapon was one level higher than a Planet-level weapon.

He did not stay where he was for long and strode forward.

The few people in the distance quickly retreated to the side.

Ma Zheng followed behind Lin Fan the entire time. His admiration for Lin Fan only grew stronger.

…

In the blink of an eye, a year had passed.

There were indeed more opportunities in the core region than in the outer region.

Lin Fan obtained three Domain Lord-level weapons and one Planet-level weapon. He also obtained a few special fruits.

This was definitely a great harvest for ordinary people.

However, Lin Fan’s interest was lacking.

This was because these treasures were nothing compared to the things he had obtained from the system.

In fact, Lin Fan was starting to miss the outer region.

At the very least, there were more exotic beasts in the outer region. After killing them, he could obtain experience points.

Lin Fan did not search around the core region. Instead, he continued to move forward, heading toward the depths.

Not long after, a hundred-meter-tall stone tablet appeared in his vision.

Many people were sitting cross-legged around the stone tablet.

Energy circulated around their bodies, and a very special aura pervaded the air.

“It’s the Enlightenment Tablet!” Ma Zheng said excitedly.

“Oh?” Lin Fan was puzzled.

“This is a stone tablet left behind by a super expert. It contains his comprehension of cultivation and the power of many laws. As long as you cultivate around this stone tablet, you can enter a deep state of cultivation. You even have the chance to enter a state of enlightenment and continuously break through!”

At this point, Ma Zheng became extremely excited.

It was as if he could see himself breaking through to the realm he had always dreamed of.

“Also, there’s an unwritten rule in the Enlightenment Tablet that forbids fighting. Violators will be attacked.”

He could not be blamed for reminding Lin Fan.

This was what Lin Fan had been doing all these years.

If there was a disagreement, he would directly kill the enemy.

He was cold-blooded and powerful!

However, there were so many cultivators here.

Ma Zheng was worried that even Lin Fan would be in danger.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, let’s find a place to cultivate.”

“Alright,” Ma Zheng said.

There were indeed many people around the stone tablet, but fortunately, the stone tablet was big enough, and there were still many empty seats.

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng sat cross-legged in the upper left corner. Their beings soon became very ethereal.

When they circulated their cultivation techniques or the power of laws, it was as if a guiding force had appeared in the unseen world. It allowed them to cultivate far more efficiently than before.

Ma Zheng was pleasantly surprised.

He felt that as long as he cultivated here for a few years, it was possible for him to break through one or even two minor realms.

As expected of the Enlightenment Tablet!

Lin Fan frowned.

Although it was somewhat helpful for cultivation, he help was too limited.

Enlightenment?

Lin Fan quickly thought of the enlightenment he had obtained after entering the Heavenly Wind World and completing the system mission.

It was cultivation anyway, so he might as well use it now.

If he wanted to do it, he would do it.

‘Use Heaven and Earth Enlightenment!’ Lin Fan thought to himself.

Instantly, Lin Fan’s surroundings were filled with an extremely mysterious aura.

Then, wisps of white energy visible to the naked eye appeared in the air.

The white energy seemed to be attracted by Lin Fan as it revolved around him, wrapping him up like a huge cocoon.

A gust of wind blew across the entire Enlightenment Tablet area, making everyone feel relaxed and happy.

At the same time, many people stopped cultivating and looked around carefully and curiously.

When they saw Lin Fan, who was surrounded by the white energy, everyone’s eyes widened as they cried out in shock.

“Someone actually had an epiphany?!”
